integrity_statement: Finite certificates and a standalone checker support a separate all-length locality-and-concatenation proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for simple cycle prisms; does not prove the five-colour conjecture on all subcubic graphs. No classification/count of all optimal colourings. Foundational 2024 and 2025 article full texts were not fully accessible; independent novelty and mathematical checks remain outstanding.
title: Sharp rich-neighbor five-colouring of every cycle prism
